office_does: The sheriff runs county law enforcement countywide and the county jail, with its deputies, corrections staff and dispatchers.
race_blurb: A rematch of 2022: Sheriff Dale Wagner, at the office since 1997 and sheriff since 2015 or 2016, faces Matthew Carlson, who spent 12 of his 29 years in law enforcement with the Ritzville police; both prefer the Republican Party. Wagner beat Carlson 2,180 to 1,710 in 2022 and led the August primary 1,329 to 1,060.

candidates.summary: Adams County Sheriff since 2015 or 2016 (sources differ) and at the sheriff's office since 1997, running on staffing, training, equipment and the jail remodel.
highlights: Would recruit and retain staff and give deputies, corrections officers and dispatchers training and modern equipment [S1]
Would keep seeking funding for jail improvements; coordinating the new jail work [S1][S4]
Backs youth-outreach programs and 'responsible technology, transparency, and accountability' [S1]
Supports lawful cooperation with federal immigration authorities on serious crimes; testified to a U.S. House subcommittee in 2025 [S2][S6]

experience.basis: Sheriff since 2015 or 2016 after a 28-year career rising through the same office, running on that record.

safety.basis: Priorities are staffing, training, equipment and jail capacity, with youth outreach and community-trust programs alongside; no diversion or treatment agenda.

candidates.summary: Ritzville law enforcement officer for 12 of his 29 years in policing, after Military Police and Killeen, Texas, service; runs on community presence and trust. Lost to Wagner in 2022.
highlights: 29 years in law enforcement: Military Police, Killeen (Texas) police and Ritzville police [S2]
Says leadership 'starts with showing up, listening to people, and staying connected to the community' [S1]
Says immigration enforcement is 'a federal job' for federal agencies [S2]
Applied to be Ritzville's police chief in 2024 [S4]

experience.basis: Never held elected office and challenges the sitting sheriff, though he is a career police officer, so the outsider case is partial.
